text: Android release build: keystore, R8/kotlinx-serialization keep rules, release APK

Done in 7d8dae4 (+ 57ae214 for the p23q.org/shopping default URL, requested
alongside). Release pipeline:
- Keystore: android/keystore/release.jks (RSA-2048, 10k days, alias
  "shoppinglist"), credentials in android/keystore.properties — both gitignored;
  build.gradle.kts loads them only if present, so fresh checkouts still build
  debug. Keystore + properties handed to the owner for backup (same key needed
  for install-over-install updates).
- R8 minify+shrinkResources: 16MB debug -> 2.1MB release. Two rule sets needed:
  (1) kotlinx-serialization keeps for org.p23q.shoppinglist.**$$serializer +
  Companion serializer() (Retrofit converter does runtime serializer lookup);
  (2) -dontwarn com.google.errorprone.annotations.** — Tink (via
  androidx.security-crypto) references compile-only annotations, which fails R8
  as "Missing class" otherwise (hit on the first build, fixed per R8's own
  missing_rules.txt).
- testReleaseUnitTest green (incl. DevCertTrustReleaseTest: TLS bypass absent
  from release). apksigner verify --print-certs matches the keystore cert
  (SHA-256 f531487f...). versionName bumped to 1.0.0.
Residual: R8-minified build is runtime-verified only by unit tests; first real
on-device run of the RELEASE apk (serialization round-trips especially) is part
of the user's T-29 pass — install requires uninstalling the debug build first
(different signing keys).
